note: Malaysia's Immigration Department: nationals of the countries it lists need a visa (those marked may enter by air only), ASEAN nationals except Myanmar's need none for less than a month, and Indians are exempt until 31 December 2026, for a stay the page doesn't set. Everyone else enters without a visa, the stay set on the social visit pass at the border (not on this page, so not modelled). Afghans need a visa approval letter first.

sources.title: Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia, Visa Requirement by Country
sources.said: Countries required to apply for a visa to enter Malaysia (List of involved countries) ***Afghanistan (VDR) Angola* Bangladesh Bhutan Burkina Faso* Burundi* Cameroon* Central African Republic* Colombia Democratic Republic of Congo* Congo Republic* Djibouti* Equatorial Guinea* Eritrea* Ethiopia* Ghana* Guinea-Bissau* India** Ivory Coast (Cote D’ Ivoire)* Liberia* Mali* Montenegro Mozambique* Nepal Nigeria* Niger* Pakistan Rwanda* Serbia Sri Lanka NOTE For countries marked as (*) are allowed to enter Malaysia by air only. India** citizen: visa exempts until 31st December 2026. ... Visa is not required for a stay of less than one (1) month for ASEAN nationals except Myanmar.
